description: Check a catalog skill's security before using it. Pass source + skill as find_skill printed them. Edge checks the catalog bundle before load or reuses a current exact-bundle audit, then shows findings, date, and the serve or withhold decision. To scan a skill on the user's machine, use the local Edge connector (npx @getedge/mcp). Relay the decision and findings; automated checks are not a guarantee.

skill.description: Catalog skill: the Skill printed by find_skill (owner/repository@skill also works)

source.description: Catalog skill: the Source printed by find_skill, usually owner/repository

name: scan_skill
title: Edge Skills: skill security audits
